learning.why: Teacher showed two examples linking harvest times to festival dates
Teacher clearly connected Pongal to January rice harvest and Baisakhi to April wheat harvest
Teacher ne clearly link dikhaya ki Pongal January mein isliye hai kyunki tab nayi chawal ki fasal ready hoti hai, aur harvest ke hisaab se alag-alag festivals hote hain.

end.summary:
Discussed harvest festivals including Pongal, Baisakhi, and Bihu.
Connected Pongal with the new rice harvest and Baisakhi with wheat after discussion.
Recognised that festivals differ across regions and may be celebrated in different ways.
Mentioned Diwali lights and sweets, and Makar Sankranti til laddoos with jaggery.
Teach-back was not passed; regional celebration description needed more support.
end.parentNote: Kavya practised linking harvest festivals with the crops ready for harvest and comparing celebrations across regions. They first thought festival dates could be random, then corrected this by connecting Pongal with the January rice harvest. Using examples such as lights, rangoli, Kali Puja, Onam, and Bihu helped with regional differences, while describing one regional celebration still needs practice. At home, ask Kavya to describe one festival using its season, food, clothes, decorations, or flowers.
